text:
"다른 공동양육자가 생성한 초대코드가 있다면 해당 아이의 데이터를 쉽게 가져올 수 있습니다. 만약 초대코드가 없다면 직접 아이 정보를 입력하거나, 공동 양육자에게 코드를 요청해 베이비타임을 사용하실 수 있습니다."

Translation: "If there is an invitation code created by another co-parent, you can easily retrieve the child's data. If there is no invitation code, you can either enter the child's information directly or request the code from the co-parent to use BabyTime."
The image shows a text box with the Korean text "네, 코드가 있습니다." which translates to "Yes, there is a code."

Text in Korean: "아기 정보 등록"
Translation: "Register Baby Information"
The text in the image is in Korean and reads "초대 코드가 있으신가요?" which translates to "Do you have an invitation code?"
"Status bar showing various icons from left to right: signal strength, Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, battery level, and time (9:34)."
Button with Korean text that reads, "아니요, 직접 아이를 등록하겠습니다," which translates to "No, I will register the child myself."
Alt text: "Back button icon, represented by a left-pointing triangle."
"Progress indicator showing four steps. Step 1 is completed with a checkmark, Step 2 is highlighted, and Steps 3 and 4 are inactive."

summarization:
This smartphone UI screen is for registering baby information. The main content asks if the user has an invitation code. It explains that if the user has an invitation code generated by another co-parent, they can easily import the baby's data. If the user does not have an invitation code, they can either enter the baby's information manually or request a code from the co-parent to use the BabyTime app.

There are two main buttons:
1. "네, 코드가 있습니다." (Yes, I have a code.)
2. "아니요, 직접 아이를 등록하겠습니다." (No, I will register the baby directly.)
